deals.title: Barnes & Noble 50% off Criterion Collection sale (4K UHD included)
deals.detail: Half-off Criterion sale on 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD through Dec. 6, per Popular Science (Nov. 11). 4K picks it names: The Princess Bride, No Country for Old Men and Blue Velvet $24.99 each; Seven Samurai 4K $29.99; Wes Anderson Archive 4K set $249.99.

deals.title: Criterion Collection 50% off at Amazon (4K UHD included)
deals.detail: 50% off Criterion 4K UHD, Blu-ray and DVD through Dec. 7, per Consequence. 4K picks include The Silence of the Lambs, The Princess Bride and No Country for Old Men; the Complete Stanley Kubrick 4K Collection is $299.98.

deals.title: KPop Demon Hunters (Criterion 4K UHD)
deals.detail: 4K UHD for $24.98 (list $49.95), part of the Criterion 50% off sale, per HD Report.

deals.title: WALL-E (Criterion 4K UHD + Blu-ray)
deals.detail: $24.98 with free shipping with Prime or on $35+, per a Slickdeals post from Nov. 17.

deals.title: Blow Out (Criterion 4K UHD + Blu-ray)
deals.detail: $26.36 per a Dealnews listing from Nov. 23, which shows the deal expiring Dec. 23.

deals.title: Back to the Future Trilogy: 40th Anniversary Edition (4K + Blu-ray + Digital)
deals.detail: $24.99 per a Slickdeals post from Nov. 19; the poster called it the lowest price yet for the 4K set.

deals.title: The Lord of the Rings: Motion Picture Trilogy (4K UHD, Extended + Theatrical)
deals.detail: $50 (down from $90) per a Slickdeals post from Nov. 23; Walmart had the same price.

deals.title: Amazon 3 for $33 on select 4K Blu-rays
deals.detail: Buy three eligible 4K discs for $33, per a Slickdeals post from Nov. 21; titles listed include Apollo 13, Waterworld, Creed II, Fast X and Jurassic World. Only items sold by Amazon count.

deals.title: GRUV Black Friday: 4K UHDs $12.99 each, plus 3 for $33
deals.detail: GRUV's Black Friday collection lists 4K UHDs at $12.99 each, including Obsession, Supergirl and Wicked: For Good. A Nov. 13 report says the sale has 49 titles at $12.99 (One Battle After Another among them) and a separate 3 for $33 4K offer.

deals.title: 100+ 4K Blu-rays $13 and under (GRUV via Walmart)
deals.detail: Per a Slickdeals post from Nov. 12, GRUV's Walmart storefront has 4K titles such as Superman, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, F1, Akira, Wuthering Heights and Mortal Kombat II at about $12.99 each.

deals.title: The Polar Express (4K Ultra HD + Blu-ray)
deals.detail: $9.99 with free shipping from GRUV via Walmart, per a Slickdeals post from Nov. 23.

deals.title: A Christmas Story (4K Ultra HD + Blu-ray)
deals.detail: $9.99 from GRUV via Walmart, per a Slickdeals post from Nov. 23; returnable until Jan. 31, 2027.

deals.title: National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation (4K Ultra HD + Blu-ray)
deals.detail: $9.99 from GRUV via Walmart, per a Slickdeals post from Nov. 23.

deals.title: Walmart Black Friday movie deals (4K titles)
deals.detail: Walmart's Black Friday movies page lists 4K combos such as Disclosure Day $12.99 (was $29.96), A Charlie Brown Thanksgiving $9.99, Ratatouille $18.53 and Coco $21.18.

deals.title: MVD Annual Black Friday & Cyber Week Sale
deals.detail: 3,500+ titles on sale through Dec. 7, prices from 99 cents. 4K example on MVD's sale page: Maniac (4K UHD + Blu-ray) $24.99, down from $49.95.

deals.title: Radiance Films Black Friday sale
deals.detail: Radiance's own sale page says its Black Friday sale runs until Dec. 9. Check each title for a 4K edition; the page didn't show specific 4K prices in what I could see.

deals.title: Umbrella Entertainment Black Friday (4K UHD)
deals.detail: Umbrella's Black Friday page offers buy one get one free on selected releases and 60% off the Terrifier box set; Collector's Editions, new releases and pre-orders are excluded. The page doesn't show end dates. Ships from Australia.

deals.title: Shout! Factory 4K UHDs on sale
deals.detail: Shout's 4K on-sale page lists Collector's Edition 4K + Blu-ray sets such as The Holdovers $27.99, Nightcrawler $32.99 and End of Watch $33.23.
